```plato

    //==
    // # Worley (cellular) noise
    //
    // One feature point per lattice cell; the value combines the distances to the
    // nearest feature points. The 3x3 (3x3x3) neighbourhood is enough because a
    // jittered feature point never leaves its own cell, so nothing outside the
    // ring can be nearer than something inside it.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Worley_noise

    // The distance from the query offset to the feature point of the k-th cell of
    // the 3x3 neighbourhood, k counted row-major from the lower-left cell.
    WorleyNeighbour2D(self: WorleyNoise2D, i: Integer, j: Integer, fx: Number, fy: Number, k: Integer): Number {
        var dx = k % 3 - 1;
        var dy = k / 3 - 1;
        var feature = FeatureOffset2D(self.Seed, i + dx, j + dy, self.Jitter);
        var offset = Vector2D(dx.ToNumber + feature.X - fx, dy.ToNumber + feature.Y - fy);
        return WorleyLength(offset, self.Distance);
    }
```
